name: Cantala Ruins
description: Many caves in Storm Island are passages to an ancient dungeon. It is the Lost City of Cantala, filled with mazes, secret chambers, and even an underground forest sustained by a strange spell that keeps the trees alive. Historically, the inhabitants were renowned for their knowledge of astronomy and their unique star spells. The kemets have already found some papers containing a few of their spells, but they are still studying how to use these instructions. At every entrance to the dungeon stands an indestructible statue of a woman holding a star and the name Amarila at its base. Recently, all these statues began to shed tears for unknown reasons. It is not easy to reach this place since it’s located within the heart of the Storm Islands, but many adventurers dream of the powerful relics that can be found there.
